record.name: Arbiter
record.description: Arbiters are masters of mediation and conflict resolution. They excel at settling disputes, interpreting laws, and using the Force to bring about fair and just resolutions to complex conflicts.

subclass_identity_profile.core_fantasy: A champion of balance and justice, an Arbiter mediates disputes and resolves conflicts through wisdom and the Force.

progression_tree.description: You have become a respected mediator, and others seek your counsel to resolve conflicts peacefully.

effects.notes: The Arbiter's wise and measured words carry weight, granting them advantage on Intimidation and Insight checks.

progression_tree.description: You have gained a reputation as a fair and impartial judge, and others seek your expertise to settle disputes.

effects.notes: When the Arbiter scores a hit, they instinctively gauge their opponent's equipment. For one turn, the Arbiter gains proficiency in the type of equipment used by the target.

progression_tree.description: You have mastered the art of resolving conflicts peacefully, and others seek your guidance to avoid violence.

effects.notes: As the Arbiter resolves conflicts, a soothing aura radiates from them, granting resistance to damage for a brief moment. When hit by an attack, the Arbiter's energy shields activate, imbuing their being with a calming resilience that reduces the impact of incoming harm.

progression_tree.description: You have become a respected leader, and others seek your guidance to make wise decisions.

effects.notes: The consular imbues nearby allies with insight, granting them increased perception and strategic acumen.

dynamic_visuals.combat_stance: Assumes a stance with feet shoulder-width apart, lightsaber at the ready, and eyes fixed intently on the opponent.
dynamic_visuals.energy_signature: Surrounds itself with an aura of calm determination, as if the very fabric of balance is being maintained.

prompt_schema.base_prompt: Generate an image of an Arbiter meditating in a serene environment, surrounded by the gentle hum of the Force.
